counting_rules.attributed_contribution_pull_requests: Every public PR returned by GitHub Search for is:pr is:public author:<account>. Copilot-authored PRs returned by an account query count as account-directed contributions while retaining Copilot as the detail author.
counting_rules.authored_pull_requests: Public PRs whose current detailed PR author login equals one of the requested accounts.
counting_rules.delivery_state: Capability availability is primary: implementations available from a public fork or public PR branch remain delivered work. Upstream adoption is retained as separate provenance.
counting_rules.direct_fork_delivery: Account-attributed commits reachable from a public fork branch, absent from current upstream branches, and not covered by a collected PR.
counting_rules.external_upstream_merge: Merged account-authored PR whose base repository is not one of the included accounts' currently owned public repositories.
counting_rules.owned_branch_commits: Unique repository-plus-SHA occurrences returned by GitHub's author or committer filter from every current branch tip in an included account's public repository.
counting_rules.strict_authored_commits: Unique repository-plus-SHA occurrences whose GitHub-resolved author login equals an included account.
counting_rules.submitted_pr_context_commits: Every surviving commit on every Search-discovered submitted PR. Context commits remain separate from strict account authorship counts.
